(KTSL)''' is an Indian multinational company specializing in Digital Engineering and [[technology]] consulting services, headquartered in [[Hyderabad]], [[India]] with offices in [[United States]] and [[Europe]]. The company reported net revenues of USD 110.6 Million in FY22-23 with more than 1800 employees.{{Cite web |last=Kurmanath |first=K. V. |date=2021-07-06 |title=Kellton Tech eyes revenues of $300 mn, to hire 400 employees |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/kellton-tech-eyes-revenues-of-300-mn-to-hire-400-employees/article35161928.ece |access-date=2022-09-12 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Kellton Tech Annual Report 2015-16 |url=https://kellton-revamp-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2019-05/Kellton%20Tech%20Annual%20Report%202015-16.pdf}}{{Cite web |title=Kellton Tech Annual Report 2016-17 |url=https://kellton-revamp-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/s3fs-public/2019-05/KT%20Annual%20Report%202016-2017.pdf}} == History == Kellton Tech Solutions Ltd. (KTSL) was established in 2009 by Niranjan Chintam and Krishna Chintam. The company's name, ‘Kellton,’ was inspired by the founders' alma maters, the Kellogg School of Management and Wharton Business School. '''Early Beginnings (Pre-2009)''' The US-based serial entrepreneurs Niranjan Chintam and Krishna Chintam took over VMF Soft Tech Ltd. in 2009 and renamed it to Kellton Tech.{{Cite web|title = Vasanthi Marine Foods changes company name to Kellton Tech Solutions| date=16 November 2012 |url = http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/announcements/vasanthi-marine-foods-changes-company-name-to-kellton-tech-solutions_783371.html}} Kellton has, since then, expanded their business portfolio by making acquisitions in the US and India.{{Cite web|title = From VMF Soft to Kellton Tech, a Bumpy Ride for Chintam Brothers|url = http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/hyderabad/From-VMF-Soft-to-Kellton-Tech-a-Bumpy-Ride-for-Chintam-Brothers/2015/08/06/article2960140.ece|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150809235021/http://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/hyderabad/From-VMF-Soft-to-Kellton-Tech-a-Bumpy-Ride-for-Chintam-Brothers/2015/08/06/article2960140.ece|url-status = dead|archive-date = 9 August 2015}} '''Kellton (2022 - Present)''' In March 2022, Kellton Tech announced its strategic business realignment, OneKellton’ initiative rebranding itself to Kellton and integrating its global operations to enhance client services.Kellton Tech Announces Strategic Business Restructuring Under 'OneKellton' Initiative{{Cite web |title=Kellton Tech announces strategic business restructuring under 'OneKellton' initiative |url=https://indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/kellton-tech-announces-strategic-business-restructuring-under-onekellton-initiative-122031600193_1.html |access-date=2023-08-06 |website=indiainfoline.com |language=en}} == Locations == The company has offices in [[Hyderabad]], [[Gurgaon]], and Pune in India; Singapore in APAC; London, Poland, [[Ireland]],{{Cite news |date=30 April 2016 |title=Indian IT firm Kellton Tech to set up base in Ireland |url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/indian-it-firm-kellton-tech-to-set-up-base-in-ireland/articleshow/52052858.cms |newspaper=The Economic Times}} and UAE in EMEA; and at the Dallas, D.C., and NY/NJ areas in the [[United States]]. Its head offices are located in Hyderabad, India, and Plano, Texas, USA. == Acquisitions == Source: * 2013: Acquired Supremesoft Global Inc, Inc. US based IT consulting company{{Cite web |title=Kellton Tech Solutions to acquire US-based Supremesoft Global {{!}} VCCircle |url=http://www.vccircle.com/news/technology/2013/10/22/kellton-tech-solutions-acquire-us-based-supremesoft-global |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107221553/https://www.vccircle.com/kellton-tech-solutions-acquire-us-based-supremesoft-global/ |archive-date=November 7, 2017 |access-date=2016-04-19 |website=www.vccircle.com}} * 2014: Acquired Vivos Professional Services, LLC, USA focusing in the life sciences and healthcare service{{Cite web|url=https://www.prweb.com/releases/kellton_tech_completes_the_acquisition_of_vivos_professional_services_llc_new_jersey_usa/prweb12286399.htm|title=Kellton Tech Completes the Acquisition of VIVOS Professional Services, LLC. New Jersey, USA|website=PRWeb|access-date=2016-04-19}} * 2014: Acquired eVantage Technologies Inc., US-based IT consulting company * 2015: Acquired US-based Prosoft Technology Group, ERP-EAI provider * 2016: Acquired US-based Bokanyi Consulting, an enterprise, analytics and cloud services provider * 2017: Acquired US-based Lenmar Group of Companies, an IT services and solutions group with presence in banking and financial services{{Cite news|title = In BFSI thrust, Kellton Tech buys US-based Lenmar Group| newspaper=The Economic Times | date=30 March 2017 |url = http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/ites/kellton-tech-acquires-us-based-lenmar-group/articleshow/57912299.cms}} *2019: Acquired US-based firm known as Tivix that develops cloud-connected web and mobile applications *2023: Acquired Hooper Labs, a US-based firm in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Hyper-automation.{{Cite web |title=News & Announcements |url=https://www.hooperlabs.com/news-announcements |access-date=2024-04-02 |website=hooperlabs.com}} == References == {{Reflist}} [[Category:Companies based in Hyderabad, India]] [[Category:Software companies of India]] [[Category:Information technology consulting firms of India]] [[Category:Business process outsourcing companies of India]] [[Category:2009 establishments in Andhra Pradesh]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Multinational companies headquartered in India]]
